history.name: Every page identifies itself
history.description: Each printed page carries a footer naming the product, the document, its version and date, with the page number and the total — so a page separated from the rest, or printed out and passed around, still says what it belongs to.
history.dev_notes: The footer lives in the paper margin outside the page's own stylesheet; the document supplies its text through a meta tag that the print step reads, which keeps the printer generic.
